article.title: Google Cloud金鑰管理服務正式支援NIST後量子密碼標準
article.summary: 雲端服務業者Google Cloud宣布，旗下金鑰管理服務Cloud Key Management Service（Cloud KMS）正式支援模組格基式金鑰封裝機制（ML-KEM），以及量子安全數位簽章，企業可直接透過Cloud KMS使用美國國家標準暨技術研究院（NIST）制定的抗量子密碼演算法，推動後量子密碼學（PQC）轉型。

article.title: OpenAI just made ChatGPT’s latest model more accessible to non-paying users
article.summary: TL;DR OpenAI’s latest ChatGPT update brings meaningful upgrades to the GPT-5.6 lineup. The top-tier GPT-5.6 Sol model will now make fewer factual errors, limit unnecessary information, and can adapt its reasoning based on your query. Free users are moving from GPT-5.5 Instant to GPT-5.6 Luna with unlimited text chats and a new Think button for deeper reasoning. ChatGPT’s latest 5.6 model lineup made its official debut early in July. Less than a month later, the AI giant is already giving the state-of-the-art models a brain and accessibility boost. As you may recall, the 5.6 series consists of three models: Sol, Terra, and Luna. There’s no update to Terra, but GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-5.6 Luna are getting meaningful upgrades . These range from making the models more reliable, accurate, and focus
